title: Sri Lanka tax and labour basics (sample)

items.text: Sri Lanka VAT: value added tax is charged at 18% on most taxable supplies, from 1 January 2024.
Sri Lanka VAT: a registered business pays the VAT for a month by the 20th day of the following month.
Sri Lanka APIT: income tax deducted from employees' pay (APIT) is paid to the Inland Revenue Department by the 15th day of the following month.
Sri Lanka EPF: the employee contributes 8% and the employer 12% of the employee's total monthly earnings to the Employees' Provident Fund.
Sri Lanka EPF: contributions for a month are paid by the last working day of the following month.
Sri Lanka ETF: the employer contributes 3% of each employee's total monthly earnings to the Employees' Trust Fund, paid by the last working day of the following month.
